name: Cult of Baldur
description:
Once per quest, you may call upon the spirit of Baldur for guidance. You may ask him one question and the GM will provide an answer.

Baldur is not omnipotent, nor does he have any special knowledge of recent events. He will provide generally sound advice based on the information you give him, though he has a bias toward action and the pursuit of your personal goals (and/or his own goals, if that is part of your campaign world).

Describe how you commune with the spirit of Baldur.
